title: She told me the delivery would be late

lines.en: Hi, Mina. The main office told me this morning that your parcel would arrive today.
lines.pt: Oi, Mina. A central me disse hoje de manhã que a sua encomenda chegaria hoje.

lines.en: That’s strange. A woman from the courier called me an hour ago about a delay.
lines.pt: Que estranho. Uma mulher da transportadora me ligou há uma hora por causa de um atraso.

lines.en: Really? Did she say why? Vans often break down on busy days.
lines.pt: Sério? Ela disse por quê? As vans costumam quebrar em dias movimentados.

lines.en: She said that the van was broken and the driver was ill, so nothing left before noon.
lines.pt: Ela disse que a van estava quebrada e o motorista estava doente, então nada saiu antes do meio-dia.

lines.en: Oh, I see. The good news is that your box is already on the shelf behind me.
lines.pt: Ah, entendi. A boa notícia é que a sua caixa já está na prateleira atrás de mim.

lines.en: Oh, wonderful! I was worried it had gone to the wrong address, like my last package.
lines.pt: Ah, que ótimo! Eu estava preocupada que tivesse ido ao endereço errado, como o meu último pacote.

lines.en: No, nothing like that. The manager put it aside yesterday, but nobody updated the tracking.
lines.pt: Não, nada disso. O gerente separou ontem, mas ninguém atualizou o rastreamento.

lines.en: That’s a relief. A friend told me that a neighbor could collect it, but he’s out of town.
lines.pt: Que alívio. Uma amiga me disse que um vizinho poderia retirar, mas ele está fora da cidade.

lines.en: He’d need an ID anyway. Do you have yours with you, or only a photo?
lines.pt: Ele precisaria de um documento mesmo assim. Você está com o seu, ou só com uma foto?

lines.en: I have my driver’s license. Can I sign now, or do I have to wait first?
lines.pt: Estou com a minha carteira de motorista. Posso assinar agora, ou preciso esperar antes?

lines.en: Here you go. Thanks for being so patient, and have a great afternoon.
lines.pt: Aqui está. Obrigada por ser tão paciente, e tenha uma ótima tarde.

facts.big: She told me it would be late
facts.label: Discurso indireto
facts.sub: Use told me + that + would: She told me that the delivery would be late.

facts.label: me disse que
facts.sub: Use told me that + frase para contar o que alguém disse: She told me that the parcel would come. Você precisa dizer a pessoa: told me, told him, told us.

facts.label: Um passo atrás
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, o verbo volta: is vira was, can vira could, will vira would. Exemplo: “It will be late” vira She said it would be late.

compare.ask: She told me it would be late.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Ela me disse que a entrega atrasaria”.
compare.tip: Diga: “She told me it would be late.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use told me + that + verbo no passado: She told me that the delivery would be late. Use would no lugar de will. Say usa sem pessoa: She said that…

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: A late delivery in Leeds · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Saturday in Leeds. Sara comes into the post office. She holds a card from the courier. Eli works at the counter. Many people wait for their parcels. Sara wants to know the truth.

“Hi, Sara. The main office told me this morning that your parcel would arrive today.” says Eli. “That’s strange. A woman called me and told me that the delivery would be late.” says Sara. “Really? Did she say why it would be late?” says Eli.

pages.title: A late delivery in Leeds · 3/3
paragraphs: “Wonderful! She told me that it would be here by noon, and it is noon now.” says Sara. “Here it is. I told you that it would be easy, and it was.” says Eli. News is easier to trust when two people agree.
